description: PDF generator — pure LOOK, no native code and no external service. A document builder with multi-page flow, automatic word-wrap, alignment, colors and tables, plus low-level text/line/rect ops and drop-in QR/barcode helpers. Turkish-safe (Differences encoding), real font metrics for accurate layout, ASCII output. Made for invoices, reports, receipts and labels. Verified against pypdf.
author: codlook
